toe.definition:
n. one of the digits of the foot
n. the part of footwear that provides a covering for the toes
n. forepart of a hoof
n. (golf) the part of a clubhead farthest from the shaft
toe.translation:
n. 足趾, 趾部, 脚趾
vt. 以趾踏触, 用脚尖走
vi. 动脚尖

toe a scratch.translation: 站在起跑线上,准备行动

toe box.translation: [网络] 头套；套头；鞋因包脚趾

toe phenomenon.translation: [医] 足趾现象, 巴彬斯奇氏反射

toe sign.translation: [医] 足趾征, 巴彬斯奇氏跖反射

toe the mark.translation: 用脚尖踏在起跑线上, 遵守规则, 符合标准

toe the scratch.translation: 用脚尖踩在起跑线上, 遵守规则

toe-curling.translation: a. 让人感到非常尴尬的

toe-in.definition: n. the alignment of the front wheels of a motor vehicle closer together at the front than at the back

toe-to-toe.definition: r in close combat or at close quarters

toea.definition: n. 100 toea equal 1 kina in Papua New Guinea
toea.translation: n. 托伊（巴布亚新几内亚辅币单位）

toecap.definition: n. a protective leather or steel cover for the toe of a boot or shoe, reinforcing or decorating it
toecap.translation: n. 鞋尖装饰, 鞋头

toecapped.definition:
past tense of toecap
n. a protective leather or steel cover for the toe of a boot or shoe, reinforcing or decorating it
toecapped.translation: (toecap 的过去时) n. 鞋尖装饰, 鞋头

toecaps.definition: n. a protective leather or steel cover for the toe of a boot or shoe, reinforcing or decorating it
toecaps.translation: n. 鞋尖装饰, 鞋头( toecap的复数形式 )

toed.definition: a. having a toe or toes of a specified kind; often used in combination
toed.translation: a. 有趾的, 斜着钉进去的

toefl.translation: abbr. 托福考试（Test of English as a Foreign Language）

toehold.definition:
n. a relatively insignificant position from which future progress might be made
n. a small foothold used in climbing
n. a wrestling hold in which the toe is held and the leg is twisted against the joints
toehold.translation: n. 不稳的小立足点, 克服困难的办法, 微小的优势

toeholds.definition:
n. a relatively insignificant position from which future progress might be made
n. a small foothold used in climbing
n. a wrestling hold in which the toe is held and the leg is twisted against the joints
toeholds.translation: n. 攀登悬崖时的小立足点, 排除障碍的方法( toehold的复数形式 )

toei.translation: n. (Toei)人名；(东南亚国家华语)水

toeic.translation: n. 国际交流英语考试

toeing.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Toe

toeless.definition: a. lacking a toe or toes
toeless.translation: a. 无趾的, 无鞋尖的, 鞋尖部镂空的

toenail.definition: n. the nail at the end of a toe
toenail.translation:
n. 脚趾甲, 斜钉
[医] 趾甲

toenail ulcer.translation: [医] 趾甲溃疡, 恶性甲床炎

toenailed.definition: n. the nail at the end of a toe
toenailed.translation:
n. 脚趾甲, 斜钉
[医] 趾甲

toenailing.definition: n. the nail at the end of a toe
toenailing.translation:
n. 脚趾甲, 斜钉
[医] 趾甲

toenails.definition:
n the nail at the end of a toe
v drive obliquely
toenails.translation: n. 脚趾甲( toenail的名词复数 ); （木匠用的）斜钉

toepfer.translation: [医]特普费尔试验[胃酸定量法]; [人名] 特普弗

toepiece.translation: n. 鞋尖装饰, 鞋头

toes.definition:
n one of the digits of the foot
n the part of footwear that provides a covering for the toes
n forepart of a hoof
n (golf) the part of a clubhead farthest from the shaft
v walk so that the toes assume an indicated position or direction
v drive obliquely
v hit (a golf ball) with the toe of the club
v drive (a golf ball) with the toe of the club
v touch with the toe

toey.translation: （人或动物）神经紧张的, 焦急不安的, 躁动的
